subject: Warm bridge request: Clearwave Health AWS co-sell kickoff & intake
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aws-partner.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warm bridge request: Clearwave Health AWS co-sell kickoff & intake

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the intro to Clearwave. We had a short discovery call last week and the account looks promising for a co-sell. Quick ask: can you do a warm bridge to the AWS GTM/co-sell contact and copy the Clearwave buyer so we can set a 30–45m kickoff next week?

High level context for the bridge (one-pager attached):
- Customer: Clearwave Health (ambulatory scheduling + payments)
- Needs: low-latency private inference for appointment summarization, embeddings for search, and SOC2 evidence for procurement
- What we want from AWS: co-sell support for marketplace listing, a warm intro to the AWS field rep & commercial team, and guidance on qualification criteria for their co-sell pipeline

Proposed agenda for the kickoff call (we can adjust):
1) Introductions + objectives (5m)
2) Customer pain & infra requirements (10m)
3) Redwood solution mapping & timeline (10m)
4) Mutual Action Plan / next steps (10m)

Attachments: MAP draft (Clearwave-RI-MAP-draft.xlsx), MOU_template.pdf — both are lightweight stubs.

If you can make the intro please copy Samantha at Clearwave (Samantha Ortiz) and procurement so they see the runway. Suggested time slots: Tue Jul 6 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed Jul 7 09:00–09:45 PT.

Thanks — we’ll handle solution mapping and bring a short technical owner (Laura) for the demo portion.

—Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference — Inference for production

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Warm bridge request: Clearwave Health AWS co-sell kickoff & intake

Marcus —

Happy to help. Looping in Samantha from Clearwave and her procurement alias. I’ll also bring in our AWS Partner Field Rep (cc'd).

Samantha / Clearwave team — great to e-meet. We work with Redwood and think there’s a good alignment with your cloud strategy. Marcus and Laura from Redwood will run a short intro / MAP session to align on technical fit and co-sell motion.

Suggested slots look good — Jul 6 at 10:00 PT works for me. If that’s good for you, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a brief pre-reads pack (security checklist + marketplace listing steps).

Daniel Park

Hi Marcus / Daniel —

Thanks for the intro. Jul 6 at 10:00 PT works for Clearwave. Please send an invite and a short agenda. A couple of notes from our side before the call:

- Procurement will want SOC2 Type II evidence, data residency guidance, and an estimate of monthly egress/ingress costs for an expected 2M tokens / month workload. I attached our security intake spreadsheet (clearwave-security-reqs.xlsx) with what our security team typically asks for.
- We prefer vendors to show a marketplace listing or a clear path to an AWS Marketplace procurement flow — including contract/PO steps.
- Our technical lead (Daniel Kim) will join the call — he’s interested in a quick spike/demo of inference latency for 128-token summaries.

Agenda request: please include an initial MAP section and a short demo by Redwood’s engineering lead (Laura). Also confirm who on Redwood will own the procurement follow-up and any necessary legal/DocuSign steps.

Samantha Ortiz
Head of Platform Partnerships | Clearwave Health
samantha.ortiz@clearwavehealth.com | +1 (503) 555-7788

Attachments: clearwave-security-reqs.xlsx

Forwarding Samantha's note — good signal from procurement. Quick internal run:

- I’ll take demo ownership (latency spike + 128-token summary sample).
- Laura -> Technical lead on the call: me (I’ll bring a 10 min latency demo using a small sample).
- Karthik, can you prepare a short slide (2–3 slides) on marketplace listing timing and required docs? Offer to do the DocuSign/MOU follow-up once we have a finalized MAP. Link to HubSpot deal below.
- Marcus, please confirm that Daniel (AWS) will send the invite and include AWS GTM.

Action items: 
1) Karthik: marketplace slide + contract checklist (due Jul 2 EOD)
2) Sean: prepare an estimate of token egress cost for 2M tokens/month (rough ballpark)
3) Marcus: confirm invite + add HubSpot/deal link to invite
